dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent over Bulo Burto City, Bulo Burto District, Hiraan Region of Somalia as of 3 June 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20230327SOM, GDACS Id: 1101908** This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters over Bulo Burto City, Bulo Burto District, Hiraan Region of Somalia as observed from a Pleiades image acquired on 3 June 2023. Within the cloud free analysed area of 14 km², about 1 km² of land appear to be flooded. Water extent appears to have decreased by about 1 km² since 30 May 2023. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
